59   def pbGainEVsOne(idxParty, defeatedBattler)
   60     pkmn = pbParty(0)[idxParty]   # The Pokémon gaining EVs from defeatedBattler
   61     evYield = defeatedBattler.pokemon.evYield
   62     # Num of effort points pkmn already has
   63     evTotal = 0
   64     GameData::Stat.each_main { |s| evTotal += pkmn.ev[s.id] }
   65     # Modify EV yield based on pkmn's held item
   66     if !Battle::ItemEffects.triggerEVGainModifier(pkmn.item, pkmn, evYield)
   67       Battle::ItemEffects.triggerEVGainModifier(@initialItems[0][idxParty], pkmn, evYield)
   68     end
   69     # Double EV gain because of Pokérus
   70     if pkmn.pokerusStage >= 1   # Infected or cured
   71       evYield.each_key { |stat| evYield[stat] *= 2 }
   72     end
   73     # Gain EVs for each stat in turn
   74     if pkmn.shadowPokemon? && pkmn.heartStage <= 3 && pkmn.saved_ev
   75       pkmn.saved_ev.each_value { |e| evTotal += e }
   76       GameData::Stat.each_main do |s|
   77         evGain = evYield[s.id].clamp(0, Pokemon::EV_STAT_LIMIT - pkmn.ev[s.id] - pkmn.saved_ev[s.id])
   78         evGain = evGain.clamp(0, Pokemon::EV_LIMIT - evTotal)
   79         pkmn.saved_ev[s.id] += evGain
   80         evTotal += evGain
   81       end
   82     else
   83       GameData::Stat.each_main do |s|
   84         evGain = evYield[s.id].clamp(0, Pokemon::EV_STAT_LIMIT - pkmn.ev[s.id])
   85         evGain = evGain.clamp(0, Pokemon::EV_LIMIT - evTotal)
   86         pkmn.ev[s.id] += evGain
   87         evTotal += evGain
   88       end
   89     end
   90   end

   92   def pbGainExpOne(idxParty, defeatedBattler, numPartic, expShare, expAll, showMessages = true)
   93     pkmn = pbParty(0)[idxParty]   # The Pokémon gaining Exp from defeatedBattler
   94     growth_rate = pkmn.growth_rate
   95     # Don't bother calculating if gainer is already at max Exp
   96     if pkmn.exp >= growth_rate.maximum_exp
   97       pkmn.calc_stats   # To ensure new EVs still have an effect
   98       return
   99     end
  100     isPartic    = defeatedBattler.participants.include?(idxParty)
  101     hasExpShare = expShare.include?(idxParty)
  102     level = defeatedBattler.level
  103     # Main Exp calculation
  104     exp = 0
  105     a = level * defeatedBattler.pokemon.base_exp
  106     if expShare.length > 0 && (isPartic || hasExpShare)
  107       if numPartic == 0   # No participants, all Exp goes to Exp Share holders
  108         exp = a / (Settings::SPLIT_EXP_BETWEEN_GAINERS ? expShare.length : 1)
  109       elsif Settings::SPLIT_EXP_BETWEEN_GAINERS   # Gain from participating and/or Exp Share
  110         exp = a / (2 * numPartic) if isPartic
  111         exp += a / (2 * expShare.length) if hasExpShare
  112       else   # Gain from participating and/or Exp Share (Exp not split)
  113         exp = (isPartic) ? a : a / 2
  114       end
  115     elsif isPartic   # Participated in battle, no Exp Shares held by anyone
  116       exp = a / (Settings::SPLIT_EXP_BETWEEN_GAINERS ? numPartic : 1)
  117     elsif expAll   # Didn't participate in battle, gaining Exp due to Exp All
  118       # NOTE: Exp All works like the Exp Share from Gen 6+, not like the Exp All
  119       #       from Gen 1, i.e. Exp isn't split between all Pokémon gaining it.
  120       exp = a / 2
  121     end
  122     return if exp <= 0
  123     # Pokémon gain more Exp from trainer battles
  124     exp = (exp * 1.5).floor if Settings::MORE_EXP_FROM_TRAINER_POKEMON && trainerBattle?
  125     # Scale the gained Exp based on the gainer's level (or not)
  126     if Settings::SCALED_EXP_FORMULA
  127       exp /= 5
  128       levelAdjust = ((2 * level) + 10.0) / (pkmn.level + level + 10.0)
  129       levelAdjust **= 5
  130       levelAdjust = Math.sqrt(levelAdjust)
  131       exp *= levelAdjust
  132       exp = exp.floor
  133       exp += 1 if isPartic || hasExpShare
  134     else
  135       exp /= 7
  136     end
  137     # Foreign Pokémon gain more Exp
  138     isOutsider = (pkmn.owner.id != pbPlayer.id ||
  139                  (pkmn.owner.language != 0 && pkmn.owner.language != pbPlayer.language))
  140     if isOutsider
  141       if pkmn.owner.language != 0 && pkmn.owner.language != pbPlayer.language
  142         exp = (exp * 1.7).floor
  143       else
  144         exp = (exp * 1.5).floor
  145       end
  146     end
  147     # Exp. Charm increases Exp gained
  148     exp = exp * 3 / 2 if $bag.has?(:EXPCHARM)
  149     # Modify Exp gain based on pkmn's held item
  150     i = Battle::ItemEffects.triggerExpGainModifier(pkmn.item, pkmn, exp)
  151     if i < 0
  152       i = Battle::ItemEffects.triggerExpGainModifier(@initialItems[0][idxParty], pkmn, exp)
  153     end
  154     exp = i if i >= 0
  155     # Boost Exp gained with high affection
  156     if Settings::AFFECTION_EFFECTS && @internalBattle && pkmn.affection_level >= 4 && !pkmn.mega?
  157       exp = exp * 6 / 5
  158       isOutsider = true   # To show the "boosted Exp" message
  159     end
  160     # Make sure Exp doesn't exceed the maximum
  161     expFinal = growth_rate.add_exp(pkmn.exp, exp)
  162     expGained = expFinal - pkmn.exp
  163     return if expGained <= 0
  164     # "Exp gained" message
  165     if showMessages
  166       if isOutsider
  167         pbDisplayPaused(_INTL("{1} got a boosted {2} Exp. Points!", pkmn.name, expGained))
  168       else
  169         pbDisplayPaused(_INTL("{1} got {2} Exp. Points!", pkmn.name, expGained))
  170       end
  171     end
  172     curLevel = pkmn.level
  173     newLevel = growth_rate.level_from_exp(expFinal)
  174     if newLevel < curLevel
  175       debugInfo = "Levels: #{curLevel}->#{newLevel} | Exp: #{pkmn.exp}->#{expFinal} | gain: #{expGained}"
  176       raise _INTL("{1}'s new level is less than its current level, which shouldn't happen.", pkmn.name) + "\n[#{debugInfo}]"
  177     end
  178     # Give Exp
  179     if pkmn.shadowPokemon?
  180       if pkmn.heartStage <= 3
  181         pkmn.exp += expGained
  182         $stats.total_exp_gained += expGained
  183       end
  184       return
  185     end
  186     $stats.total_exp_gained += expGained
  187     tempExp1 = pkmn.exp
  188     battler = pbFindBattler(idxParty)
  189     loop do   # For each level gained in turn...
  190       # EXP Bar animation
  191       levelMinExp = growth_rate.minimum_exp_for_level(curLevel)
  192       levelMaxExp = growth_rate.minimum_exp_for_level(curLevel + 1)
  193       tempExp2 = (levelMaxExp < expFinal) ? levelMaxExp : expFinal
  194       pkmn.exp = tempExp2
  195       @scene.pbEXPBar(battler, levelMinExp, levelMaxExp, tempExp1, tempExp2)
  196       tempExp1 = tempExp2
  197       curLevel += 1
  198       if curLevel > newLevel
  199         # Gained all the Exp now, end the animation
  200         pkmn.calc_stats
  201         battler&.pbUpdate(false)
  202         @scene.pbRefreshOne(battler.index) if battler
  203         break
  204       end
  205       # Levelled up
  206       pbCommonAnimation("LevelUp", battler) if battler
  207       oldTotalHP = pkmn.totalhp
  208       oldAttack  = pkmn.attack
  209       oldDefense = pkmn.defense
  210       oldSpAtk   = pkmn.spatk
  211       oldSpDef   = pkmn.spdef
  212       oldSpeed   = pkmn.speed
  213       battler.pokemon.changeHappiness("levelup") if battler&.pokemon
  214       pkmn.calc_stats
  215       battler&.pbUpdate(false)
  216       @scene.pbRefreshOne(battler.index) if battler
  217       pbDisplayPaused(_INTL("{1} grew to Lv. {2}!", pkmn.name, curLevel)) { pbSEPlay("Pkmn level up") }
  218       @scene.pbLevelUp(pkmn, battler, oldTotalHP, oldAttack, oldDefense,
  219                        oldSpAtk, oldSpDef, oldSpeed)
  220       # Learn all moves learned at this level
  221       moveList = pkmn.getMoveList
  222       moveList.each { |m| pbLearnMove(idxParty, m[1]) if m[0] == curLevel }
  223     end
  224   end

  229   def pbLearnMove(idxParty, newMove)
  230     pkmn = pbParty(0)[idxParty]
  231     return if !pkmn
  232     pkmnName = pkmn.name
  233     battler = pbFindBattler(idxParty)
  234     moveName = GameData::Move.get(newMove).name
  235     # Pokémon already knows the move
  236     return if pkmn.hasMove?(newMove)
  237     # Pokémon has space for the new move; just learn it
  238     if pkmn.numMoves < Pokemon::MAX_MOVES
  239       pkmn.learn_move(newMove)
  240       pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} learned {2}!", pkmnName, moveName)) { pbSEPlay("Pkmn move learnt") }
  241       if battler
  242         battler.moves.push(Move.from_pokemon_move(self, pkmn.moves.last))
  243         battler.pbCheckFormOnMovesetChange
  244       end
  245       return
